decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - extact locations of structural walls shall be ascertained in advance (e.g. some hollow sounding "stud" walls may be lath and plaster finish on brick, or structural partitions to the ceiling joists). Where new door openings are made, adjacent to return walls, there are to be left or made nibs sufficient to support arch lintols, and accommodate architraves - these to match the original where these are of appropriate style and quality.

Condition : 4 - Further details of implications of soil and vent pipes, extract fans and other services, particularly on the exterior of the building or through the roof, shall be submitted to and agreed by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of works.
Condition : 5 - Consideration should be given to reinstating passive stack ventillation (lost with removal of chimney flues), particularly with interior kitchen and single-sided flat.
Condition : 6 - An as-built drawing shall be provided.
description: Conversion of 3 No bedsits on ground and first floor to 3 No one bedroom flats on ground and first floor incorporating internal alterations to existing residential building (LISTED BUILDING CONSENT)
